name: case-show
comment: Firewall rule list/show, firewall group list, IOA group list, correlation-rule list and case list/show add read-only operations and scopes. Their synthetic scenarios pin the compact rows, detail views, pagination and help. help-top, unknown-command and scopes change deliberately for these shipped commands; no transport enforcement changes. Firewall rule cursors bind the offset-or-token model and rule detail redacts customer_id (docs/design/v1.md section 10.6).
